panels.title: Шихтовка: содержание в питании против цели

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId == "kz.bozshakol:geology" and r._field == "value_feed_grade_1h_properties_value")

panels.title: Содержание Cu в кузовах (рудоконтроль по рейсу)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId =~ /^kz[.]bozshakol:ht-/ and r._field == "value_load_grade_properties_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, twin: r.thingId}))
  |> group(columns: ["twin"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId =~ /^kz[.]bozshakol:(sh|ld)-/ and r._field == "value_block_grade_properties_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, twin: r.thingId}))
  |> group(columns: ["twin"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

import "strings"
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId =~ /^kz[.]bozshakol:blk-/ and r._field =~ /^value_(cu|au|clay|ucs|ucs_mwd|bwi|remaining)_properties_value$/)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({twin: strings.toUpper(v: strings.split(v: r.thingId, t: ":")[1]), _value: r._value, _field: strings.trimSuffix(v: strings.trimPrefix(v: r._field, prefix: "value_"), suffix: "_properties_value")}))
  |> group(columns: ["twin"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["twin"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
